interpretation: General class is a bounded project interpretation of actual geometry, not factory acceptance. No generic .10 or .13 visible-gold-window claim is supported.
maskCondition: Require submitted mask preserved without automatic expansion, gang-opening conversion, dam removal or facet deletion; record local .13 screen separately from pending final CAM/process confirmation.
numericalPolicy: A tiny eroded-core area alone is not a waiver. Report all raw cores and geometry; distinguish floating-point remnants through source-boundary/serialization and reconstruction evidence. Keep finite necks and branches regardless of small area.
